title: Trust, but verify, audit and attribute: a human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced research results
abstract: arXiv:2611.13042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems now produce research results in bulk: in October 2026 a single laboratory released more than 700 AI-generated mathematics manuscripts, only part of them with machine-checked proofs. Such volumes will be checked mostly by AI agents that call specialised software. A passing check certifies only the artefact that was checked. For proofs translated into the proof assistant Lean, it has been shown that this artefact may state something other than the author's text, and that deciding whether a translation is faithful is undecidable in general. The human researcher therefore stays in the loop, and human and AI contributions must be recorded. We propose a domain-independent, human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced results. Validated, agent-usable tools with different grounds of trust check the results; a fidelity audit asks whether each check addressed the claim as stated; the human decides at fi

translated_title: 信任，但须验证、审计与归因：一个用于检验AI产出研究成果的人在回路框架
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）系统如今能够批量产出研究成果：2026年10月，单个实验室就发布了超过700篇AI生成的数学论文手稿，其中只有一部分附有经过机器验证的证明。如此大量的成果将主要由调用专门软件的AI代理来检验。然而，一项通过的检查仅能证明被检验的那个产物本身。对于被翻译成证明助手Lean的证明，已有研究表明该产物所陈述的内容可能与作者原文不符，而且判断一次翻译是否忠实在一般情况下是不可判定的。因此，人类研究者必须留在回路之中，并且人类与AI各自的贡献必须被记录。我们提出了一个领域无关的、人在回路的框架，用于检验AI产出的结果：由经过验证的、可供代理使用的工具基于不同的信任基础来检验结果；由忠实性审计来追问每次检验是否真正针对了原文所述的论断；由人类最终做出裁决。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个领域无关的人在回路框架，通过经过验证的AI工具检验、忠实性审计以及人类与AI贡献归因记录，来保障对AI批量产出的研究成果的有效核查。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a domain-independent human-in-the-loop framework that checks AI-produced research results through validated agent-usable tools, fidelity audits of whether each check addressed the claim as stated, and attribution of human and AI contributions.
